Name: Largemouth Bass Pixel Fix
Author: MarigoldenSkies
Description:
Inspired by screwyoucolin's [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValley/comments/cwz9mg]Reddit post about being annoyed by a missing pixel[/url], this mod replaces the transparent pixel in the Largemouth Bass sprite.

This mod adds a single pixel; fish sprites are for illustrative purposes only.

There are four options for the player:

[list]
[*]Classic: Replaces the transparent pixel with a pixel the color of the standard menu background for those who never noticed that there was a missing pixel in the first place.
[*]Green: Replaces the transparent pixel with a green pixel from the Largemouth Bass' color scheme.
[*]Neutral: Replaces the ﻿transparent pixel with a more neutral pixel from the Largemouth Bass' color scheme.
[*]Pink: Replaces the transparent pixel with a pink pixel especially for Reddit user, subtlelikeatank, who mentioned that there is sometimes a pink patch on that part of the bass.
[/list][list]
[/list]
